# Wiki Comercio Exterior MX
Legal/documentary wiki, verifiable official-source archive, and operational explorers for Mexican foreign trade.
Explore: docs/explore/ (aranceles, marco juridico, RGCE, tratados/origen, programas, RRNA/NOM, mapa, fuentes)
Wiki: docs/wiki/ (fundamentos, aduana, clasificacion, contribuciones, programas, logistica)
Official source library: docs/catalog/library.md
Source catalog: docs/catalog/
Corpus: data/corpus/
Original manifests and release index: data/originals/
Legal source/instrument IDs: sources/registry.yaml and sources/instruments.yaml
Tariff tables and structured HS/TIGIE/fraccion/NICO data: https://github.com/jccontrerasg08-cpu/arancel-mx
Canonical geospatial data and advanced map application: https://github.com/jccontrerasg08-cpu/aduanamap-mx
Cross-repository contracts: docs/methodology/cross-repo-contracts.md and data/contracts/aduanamap.yaml
Incoterms: ICC reference URLs only; do not vendor ICC rule text.
Mexico TIGIE-SCIAN: https://www.inegi.org.mx/app/tigie/ is an official interactive reference; preserve or ingest only through a documented reproducible source path.
Archive presence, URL health, and checksums do not determine legal currentness.
